decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of the already popular Demeter range that remained on the website into 2024, it fits core capabilities and strategy, so its option value is high and the case for abandonment is weak.

This is a very recent sliced-cheese line extension in the firm's core dairy business, so uncertainty about demand is still being resolved and the likely cost of keeping it for another selling cycle is modest.

As a newly launched sliced Butterkäse based on established cheesemaking capabilities and a familiar German variety, it is inexpensive to continue testing for another year unless market results turn clearly negative.
